text:
maya: Deploy-bot just paused the payments canary, flagging a subchart/version skew. canary id: canary-2026-03-payments. Anyone around to triage?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary paused: detected chart version mismatch. parent/chart: payments v2.4.1, payments-subchart: v2.3.9. Health check failed on 3/50 pods. Action: PAUSE_CANARY. See /deploy/logs/1799994321

chris: ack. quick Q — did the chart lockfile get updated in the last promo?

paul: I peeked at the PR. Parent bump to v2.4.1 included a subchart bump to v2.4.0 in the PR description, but the Chart.lock in the release artifacts still references 2.3.9. Likely an artifact publish step skipped.

maya: thanks. So two options: 1) pin the parent to use 2.3.9 (fast) or 2) rebuild/publish artifacts with subchart v2.4.0 and re-run canary (safer). What's the org appetite for rollout delay?

toni: we should avoid rollback if possible — payment path is sensitive. I'm leaning to rebuild + republish so prod artifacts match git. How long to rebuild artifacts?

paul: artifact publish should be <15m if CI is healthy. But ops will need to approve given it's a chart artifact repo.

chris: if we rebuild, we need to update release notes + chart provenance. Also need to ensure values override for payments-subchart didn't change behavior between 2.3.9 -> 2.4.0. Can someone run a quick diff on default values?

maya: I can run the diff. Running `helm show values payments-subchart@2.3.9 > v239.yaml` and `helm show values payments-subchart@2.4.0 > v240.yaml` then `diff -u v239.yaml v240.yaml`. Will report in ~10m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder: canary paused at 2026-03-21T14:04:13Z. Lock will expire in 1h unless actioned.

oncall-sre: FYI I'm on standby if the canary needs manual rollback/restart. If we republish artifacts we should hold the release window for 30m to monitor.

maya: diff result: small change in `resources.requests.cpu` default and one extra feature flag `enableFastPath` added but default = false. No breaking API changes.

chris: sounds safe. plan: (A) rebuild chart artifacts with subchart v2.4.0, (B) publish and promote chart artifacts, (C) unpause canary to continue. Who will run the publish?

paul: I'll trigger the chart-publish CI. Steps: `make build-charts && chart-publisher --repo artifacts-repo --token $TOKEN`. Will ping here when done.

maya: also can we temporarily pin the canary to the existing artifact (2.3.9) while publish happens, to avoid more failures? Or does deploy-bot require the published artifact hash?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary runs from artifact digest in release request. Maintenance path: manual pin allowed by adding annotation `release.redwood/pin-subchart: 2.3.9` to the canary manifest. Manual pins bypass the artifact mismatch check but must be removed after republish.

chris: ok do the pin for now so traffic doesn't flip more pods. @paul go ahead with publish. @paul can you also add a short release note blurb about the subchart bump and resources CPU default change?

paul: starting publish now. ETA ~12m. Adding release note: "payments-subchart -> v2.4.0: minor resource default changes; non-default feature flag `enableFastPath` introduced (default false). No behavioral changes expected."

toni: I'll add a canary hold in the release notes: "Hold for artifact publish and 30m post-unpause verification".

maya: I've applied the manual pin annotation to the canary to keep it stable: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-2026-03-payments release.redwood/pin-subchart=2.3.9 --overwrite`

oncall-sre: copied. If publish succeeds, unpin and unpause. If anything else fails we roll back to previous full release (tag: payments-2.4.0-rollback-ready).

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Received manual pin annotation. Health checks paused but pods will not be replaced until unpinned.

paul: publish succeeded. Artifact URL: https://artifacts.internal/charts/payments/2.4.1+sub-2.4.0.tgz sha256: abcdef123... Promoting now.

chris: promotion done. @maya can you remove the pin and ask deploy-bot to resume canary?

maya: removing pin and resuming. `kubectl annotate canary/canary-2026-03-payments release.redwood/pin-subchart-; kubectl patch canary/canary-2026-03-payments -p '{"spec":{"paused":false}}' --type=merge`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary resumed. Monitoring for 30m. Health checks passing on initial pods.

maya: excellent. follow-ups: chris will add the release notes blurb to the release PR (include artifact URL and CPU default note), paul will file a quick CI postmortem for the missed lockfile, and toni will keep the hold window open for 30m.

chris: will do. writing release note now.

paul: filing CI postmortem ticket #2345, linking this thread.

toni: thanks everyone :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: monitoring. will call if we see regressions.

maya: thread resolved for now — will reopen if anything degrades.
